get_crime_rate_by_zip: get the crime rate for a given zip code using the city CLI get-crime-rate command
add_crime_rate_data: add crime rate data for a new zip code with violent and property crime rates
update_crime_rate_data: update the violent or property crime rate for an existing zip code in the database
check_api_call_count: check the current API call count to monitor usage against the rate limit
get_api_call_limit: get the API call limit for the free version of the CityApp service
